Member is an `Avatar`, the name and the email. The row-actions menu is not drawn in Figma yet. - Change a role in place with a `Select` of 2 to 4 roles. It saves at once and a `Toast` confirms, so the user never wonders whether it saved. The `Select` and the `Toast` are not drawn in Figma yet; Figma draws the role as text. - Invite is the one primary `Button` ("Invite member") in the header, at the inline-end. It opens a `Dialog` with an email `Field` ("Email address") and a role `Field` ("Role", default "Member"). The Dialog body says what each role can do ("Owners can manage billing; Admins can manage members; Members can edit content."), so the role list needs no per-row explanation. Resend and Revoke are not drawn in Figma yet. - Removing a member opens an `AlertDialog variant="destructive"`.
